key_impacts: Power lines and substations knocked out
Rail line at Dawlish damaged by a storm
Rail links with much of Cornwall and Devon cut off for several weeks
Estimated cost to the economy of £1.2bn
Hospitals were understaffed when demand for care peaked
40% reduction in the Russian grain harvest
Russian government imposed export bans to control domestic food prices
Contributed to a doubling of global grain prices (alongside shortfalls in Australia and Pakistan)
Grain price spikes causally linked with Arab Spring uprisings in North Africa and the Middle East
Estimated damage and reconstruction bill of US$80bn
New York’s main water treatment system failed because power stations were shut down
Back-up generators were inoperable due to lack of fuel supply
